### ": \t"
% :
dir1/  dir2/  file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,4
### "\t"
% : dir1/
dir1/  dir2/  file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,9
### "\u{12}"
% : dir1/
isearch backward:
dir1/  dir2/  file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,9
### "fo"
% : foo.h
wrapped isearch backward: fo
dir1/  dir2/  file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,9
### "\u{12}"
% : foo.c
wrapped isearch backward: fo
dir1/  dir2/  file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,9
### "\r"
% : foo.c
dir1/  dir2/  file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,9
### "\r"
% : foo.c
@ 0,10
